data.one_liner: Classes that help use Flutter Hooks with the stacked package architecture.
data.what_it_does: It provides widget classes like StackedHookView that bridge the stacked architecture with the flutter_hooks package. This allows you to consume ViewModels provided by Provider while utilizing hooks inside your widget build methods.
use_when: You are building an app using the stacked architecture and want to use flutter_hooks
You need to manage local UI controllers like TextEditingController within stacked views
avoid_when: You are not using the stacked architecture package
you prefer other state management solutions like Riverpod or Bloc
strengths: Integrates flutter_hooks seamlessly with stacked ViewModels
Reduces boilerplate when using TextEditingControllers and similar hooks in stacked views
weaknesses: Dependent on both stacked and flutter_hooks ecosystems
Limited functionality beyond bridging the two packages
